name: setup-manaflow-ai-starter-sidebar-view
description: A customize app that implements cmux.hovercard/1 (a three-line card: title and age, the agent's status, the branch) and cmux.sidebar.rows/1 (rows that show a dot while an agent works). While it is installed it stands in for your own customize/ view; removing it puts yours back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Starter sidebar view" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A three-line hover card (title and age, status, branch) and rows with a dot while an agent works.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
